identificationModule.officialTitle: Clinical Trial for the Safety and Efficacy of BCMA CAR-T Cell Therapy for Newly Diagnosed Multiple Myeloma

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This is a single arm, open-label, single-center study. This study is indicated for newly diagnosed multiple myeloma. The selections of dose levels and the number of subjects are based on clinical trials of similar foreign products. 40 patients will be enrolled. Primary objective is to explore the safety and efficacy

primaryOutcomes.description: Adverse events assessed according to NCI-CTCAE v5.0 criteria
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline up to 28 days after BCMA CAR T-cells infusion

primaryOutcomes.description: Incidence of treatment-emergent adverse events \[Safety and Tolerability\]
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline up to 2 years after BCMA CAR T-cells infusion

secondaryOutcomes.description: Assessment of ORR (ORR = sCR+CR+VGPR+PR+MR) at Month 6, 12, 18 and 24
Proportion of subjects who achieved morphological complete response (CR) and complete response with hematologic incomplete recovery (CRi)
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline up to 2 years after BCMA CAR T-cells infusion

secondaryOutcomes.description: Proportion of subjects who achieved a partial response (PR)
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 2 years after BCMA CAR T-cells infusion

secondaryOutcomes.description: Death from any cause from the beginning of cell transfusion
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 2 years after BCMA CAR T-cells infusion
